transcript.text: Hi, I'm Sam. Today you'll find two numbers in a list that add up to a target and return their indices. The details are on your screen; any clarifying questions?
Hi. Can the numbers be negative?
Yes, they can be negative, and there's always exactly one answer.
Okay. I think I'd use a hash map from value to index so I only go through the list once.
Sounds promising. Can you walk me through it and its complexity?
Sorry, something came up at work, I have to go. Can we stop here?

Of course. Thanks for joining; you started well by checking the input range and suggesting a one-pass idea. Next time, try to walk through the full plan and its complexity. A written report will follow; goodbye.
